newsitem.title: POLAND: Slaski sees '97 net up at PLN 356.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Slaski sees '97 net up at PLN 356.3 mln.

text.p: Polish Bank Slaski SA sees its 1997 net profit rising to 356.3 million zlotys, up from 309 million expected this year, the bank's spokesman said.

"The supervisory board of Bank Slaski approved the financial plan for the next year.... according to the plan the net profit will amount to 356.3 million zlotys," Henryk Nykiel told Parkiet financial newspaper.
In the January-November period Slaski showed a net profit of 297.5 million zlotys.
Slaski had a net profit of 257 million zlotys in 1995.
